sn35.232:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā ca sāriputto āyasmā ca mahākoṭṭhito bārāṇasiyaṃ viharanti isipatane migadāye.
sn35.232:1.2: atha kho āyasmā mahākoṭṭhito sāyanhasamayaṃ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito yenāyasmā sāriputto tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā sāriputtena saddhiṃ sammodi.
sn35.232:1.3: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā mahākoṭṭhito āyasmantaṃ sāriputtaṃ etadavoca:
sn35.232:2.1: kinnu kho āvuso sāriputta cakkhu rūpānaṃ saññojanaṃ rūpā cakkhussa saññojanaṃ, sotaṃ saddānaṃ saññojanaṃ saddā sotassa saññojanaṃ, ghānaṃ gandhānaṃ saññojanaṃ gandhā ghānassa saññojanaṃ,
sn35.232:2.2: jivhā rasānaṃ saññojanaṃ, rasā jivhāya saññojanaṃ, kāyo phoṭṭhabbānaṃ saññojanaṃ phoṭṭhabbā kāyassa saññojanaṃ,
sn35.232:2.3: mano dhammānaṃ saññojanaṃ, dhammā manassa saññojananti?
sn35.232:3.1: na kho āvuso koṭṭhita, cakkhu rūpānaṃ saññojanaṃ, na rūpā cakkhussa saññojanaṃ.
sn35.232:3.2: yañca tattha tadubhayaṃ paṭicca uppajjati chandarāgo taṃ tattha saññojanaṃ …pe…
sn35.232:3.3: na jivhā rasānaṃ saññojanaṃ, na rasā jivhāya saññojanaṃ.
sn35.232:3.4: yañca tattha tadubhayaṃ paṭicca uppajjati chandarāgo taṃ tattha saññojanaṃ …pe…
sn35.232:3.5: na mano dhammānaṃ saññojanaṃ, na dhammā manassa saññojanaṃ.
sn35.232:3.6: yañca tattha tadubhayaṃ paṭicca uppajjati chandarāgo taṃ tattha saññojanaṃ.
sn35.232:4.1: seyyathāpi āvuso kāḷo ca balivaddo odāto ca balivaddo ekena dāmena vā yottena vā saṃyuttā assu.
sn35.232:4.3: kāḷo balivaddo odātassa balivaddassa saññojanaṃ, odāto balivaddo kāḷassa balivaddassa saññojananti. sammā nu kho so vadamāno vadeyyāti.
sn35.232:4.5: na kho āvuso kāḷo balivaddo odātassa balivaddassa saññojanaṃ, napi odāto balivaddo kāḷassa balivaddassa saññojanaṃ.
sn35.232:4.6: yena ca kho te ekena dāmena vā yottena vā saṃyuttā, taṃ tattha saññojanaṃ.
sn35.232:5.1: evameva kho āvuso na cakkhu rūpānaṃ saññojanaṃ, na rūpā cakkhussa saññojanaṃ.
sn35.232:5.2: yañca tattha tadubhayaṃ paṭicca uppajjati chandarāgo taṃ tattha saññojanaṃ …pe…
sn35.232:5.4: na mano dhammānaṃ saññojanaṃ, na dhammā manassa saññojanaṃ.
sn35.232:5.5: yañca tattha tadubhayaṃ paṭicca uppajjati chandarāgo taṃ tattha saññojanaṃ.
sn35.232:6.1: cakkhuṃ vā āvuso rūpānaṃ saññojanaṃ abhavissa, rūpā vā cakkhussa saññojanaṃ abhavissa, na idaṃ brahmacariyavāso paññāyetha sammā dukkhakkhayāya,
sn35.232:6.2: yasmā ca kho āvuso na cakkhu rūpānaṃ saññojanaṃ na rūpā cakkhussa saññojanaṃ,
sn35.232:6.3: yañca tattha tadubhayaṃ paṭicca uppajjati chandarāgo taṃ tattha saññojanaṃ, tasmā brahmacariyavāso paññāyati sammādukkhakkhayāya …pe…
sn35.232:7.1: jivhā vā āvuso rasānaṃ saññojanaṃ abhavissa, rasā vā jivhāya saññojanaṃ, na idaṃ brahmacariyavāso paññāyetha sammā dukkhakkhayāya,
sn35.232:7.2: yasmā ca kho āvuso na jivhā rasānaṃ saññojanaṃ na rasā jivhāya saññojanaṃ, yañca tattha tadubhayaṃ paṭicca uppajjati chandarāgo taṃ tattha saññojanaṃ, tasmā brahmacariyavāso paññāyati sammā dukkhakkhayāya …pe…
sn35.232:8.1: mano vā āvuso dhammānaṃ saññojanaṃ abhavissa, dhammā vā manassa saññojanaṃ, nayidaṃ brahmacariyavāso paññāyetha sammā dukkhakkhayāya.
sn35.232:8.2: yasmā ca kho āvuso na mano dhammānaṃ saññojanaṃ, na dhammā manassa saññojanaṃ,
sn35.232:8.3: yañca tattha tadubhayaṃ paṭicca uppajjati chandarāgo taṃ tattha saññojanaṃ, tasmā brahmacariyavāso paññāyati sammā dukkhakkhayāya.
sn35.232:9.1: tadamināpetaṃ āvuso pariyāyena veditabbaṃ: yathā na cakkhu rūpānaṃ saññojanaṃ, na rūpā cakkhussa saññojanaṃ.
sn35.232:9.2: yañca tattha tadubhayaṃ paṭicca uppajjati chandarāgo taṃ tattha saññojanaṃ …pe…
sn35.232:9.4: na mano dhammānaṃ saññojanaṃ, na dhammā manassa saññojanaṃ.
sn35.232:9.5: yañca tattha tadubhayaṃ paṭicca uppajjati chandarāgo taṃ tattha saññojanaṃ.
sn35.232:11.1: iminā kho etaṃ āvuso pariyāyena veditabbaṃ: yathā na cakkhu rūpānaṃ saññojanaṃ, na rūpā cakkhussa saññojanaṃ,
sn35.232:11.2: yañca tattha tadubhayaṃ paṭicca uppajjati chandarāgo taṃ tattha saññojanaṃ

sn35.232:11.8: na mano dhammānaṃ saññojanaṃ, na dhammā manassa saññojanaṃ,
